KEY PRODUCT FEATURES:
• 6 Adventures in the Forgotten Realms - Draft Booster Boxes
• Beloved Dungeons & Dragons heroes and monsters have ventured into Magic for the ultimate crossover!

DESCRIPTION:
Each sealed draft booster box case contains 6 Adventures in the Forgotten Realm Draft Booster Boxes. The Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Draft Booster Box contains 36 Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Draft Boosters (540 cards total). Each Draft Booster contains 15 Magic cards and 1 token or ad card, with 1 Rare or Mythic Rare, 3 Uncommons, 10 Common cards, and 1 Land card. A traditional foil card of any rarity replaces a Common in 33% of Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Draft Boosters. Traditional foil Mythic Borderless Planeswalker in less than 1% of boosters.
